## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 8, 2026 - Sep 14, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Chrisuit1992_, Aug 23, 2026, 1/5: "The customized stories were not working well, a lot of random single letters would come up during the audio. I also experienced stories being cut off midway and continuous repetition of sentences and reloading of the story, like the software had a bug. Furthermore a lot of the stories were very corny and it all sounds a bit like chatgpt."
            2. _DaHunch_, Jul 16, 2026, 1/5: "This is vibe-coded dross. Scripts crash - random music starts playing - everything is all over the place. There are flashes of value - but it’s all buried under an avalanche of amateur coding which crashes all the time."
            3. _Darcie Thomas_, Jul 8, 2026, 2/5: "When I first found this app I went all in, personalised visualisation was exactly what I wanted and I spent the first week just going through them all feeling so happy. There was always a small technical issue with the typing but it’s something you overlook with the quality of the stories, I loved that you can request an edit if it didn’t sit right for any reason and the option to request particular scenes was everything. It made the £20 per month worth it! But with every update it almost got worse. When you request stories it went from creating two to four, meaning you would hit the limit quickly. Then it updates again, now instead of having access to all 5 of the desire stories you can only see one of each, and when you request stories you can pick from the four and the other three disappear afterwards. I have tried to edit one story as it didn’t feel right and it kept going back to a random scene from a few weeks ago, completely taking away from the scene it where it was originally. It’s become increasingly frustrating and combined with the continued typing issue I started to look elsewhere. Unfortunately I won’t be continuing after my last payment month. Charging the same price when you lose around half- or probably more actually! - of what you used to get makes no sense. The app was such a good things when I started a few months ago, it’s sad that money has become more important rather than working on a better product ."
